query: SELECT uuid AS "uuid!",owner_uri AS "owner_uri!",channel_uri AS "channel_uri!" FROM discovery_video_work WHERE job_id=$1 UNION ALL SELECT v.uuid,v.owner_uri,v.channel_uri FROM discovery_video_details v JOIN discovery_entries e ON e.id=v.entry_id WHERE e.canonical_uri=$2 UNION ALL SELECT v.uuid,v.owner_uri,v.channel_uri FROM discovery_video_work v JOIN discovery_jobs j ON j.id=v.job_id WHERE j.target_uri=$2 AND j.withdrawn LIMIT 1
